主要内容: On January 17, 2012, Optical Cable Corporation (Nasdaq GM: OCC) announced that its Board of Directors increased the regular quarterly cash dividend to shareholders by 50%. The new dividend rate is $0.015 per share, effective January 13, 2012, with payment scheduled for February 15, 2012, to shareholders of record on January 27, 2012. This represents a $0.005 per share increase over the previous rate, which was set in October 2010. The new rate implies an annual cash dividend of $0.06 per common share. The company is a leading manufacturer of fiber optic and copper data communications cabling and connectivity solutions for the enterprise market, offering a wide range of products including cabling, connectors, patch cords, and management accessories designed for demanding applications.
